message.content: {"note_claim": "A Russian drone hit the locomotive of a regular Kyiv–Warsaw train ~2 km inside Ukraine; no injuries.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "\"the enemy struck the locomotive of a passenger train,\" announced Ukrainian Railways in a statement. \"A monitoring group warned the train crew of the threat in advance, ensuring that no one was injured.\"", "reason": "The page directly confirms that a Russian drone struck the locomotive of a Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train about 2 km from the Polish border with no injuries."}

parsed.note_claim: A Russian drone hit the locomotive of a regular Kyiv–Warsaw train ~2 km inside Ukraine; no injuries.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: "the enemy struck the locomotive of a passenger train," announced Ukrainian Railways in a statement. "A monitoring group warned the train crew of the threat in advance, ensuring that no one was injured."
